key_concepts: Heat transfer occurs by conduction, convection, and radiation
Conduction is most significant in solids and between solids in thermal contact
Conduction is less significant in liquids and gases because of molecular spacing
The Sun is a major source of heat for plants and Earth
Overexposure to sunlight can cause sunburn and excessive water loss through perspiration
Heat stress can reduce feed intake, lower energy levels, and weaken the immune system
Heat transfer between plants and the environment occurs through conduction, convection, ev
Heat stress can reduce leaf water potential, leaf area, and photosynthesis
Prolonged heat stress can deplete carbohydrate reserves and cause plant starvation
Plants need sunlight, proper temperature, moisture, air, and nutrients to grow
Temperature affects photosynthesis, transpiration, respiration, and vegetative-to-reproduc
Nursery facilities help control temperature compared with backyard gardens
